commentFilter.label: Whose opinions to show
commentFilter.emptyTitle: No one from {name} has shared an opinion here yet
commentFilter.emptyDescription: Switch to Everyone to read all opinions on this place.

list.title: Communities
list.description: Your own circle on the map. Filter pins and opinions down to the people in it.
list.limitNote: You can be in up to {max} communities. {count} used.
list.limitReached: You're in {max} communities, the most you can be in. Leave one to create or join another.
list.emptyDescription: Create one for your friends, your club or your campus and invite them with a link.
list.how1: Create a community and share its invite link.
list.how2: People who open the link can join.
list.how3: Pick it on the map to see only pins and opinions from its members.
list.how4: Drop a pin for the community and only members can see and answer it. Everything else stays public.

form.createDescription: Give it a name people will recognise. You'll get an invite link right after.
form.editDescription: Members see the changes right away.
form.createdDescription: Share the invite link to bring people in.
form.colorHint: Members-only pins show in this color on the map.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or you're no longer a member.
detail.confirmRemoveDescription: They leave the community and can't rejoin with the invite link. They lose access to its members-only pins; their public pins and opinions stay.
detail.confirmLeaveDescription: You'll lose access to its members-only pins. You can rejoin later with an invite link.
detail.confirmDeleteDescription: The community and its member list are deleted for everyone. {pins, plural, =0 {Public pins and opinions stay.} one {Its # members-only pin is deleted too, with all its opinions.} other {Its # members-only pins are deleted too, with all their opinions.}} This can't be undone.
detail.confirmResetDescription: The current link stops working. People who already joined stay members.

invite.title: Invite link
invite.description: Anyone with this link can join. Share it only with people you want in.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy, select the link instead
invite.explain: Members can filter the map and opinions down to each other and drop pins only members can see.
invite.notFoundDescription: It may have been reset by the founder, or the community was deleted. Ask for a new link.

errors.removed: The founder removed you from this community.
errors.limit: You're already in the most communities you can be in. Leave one first.
